# vendor/lucide

Vendored copy of the [Lucide](https://lucide.dev) icon set, so the interface stays
fully self-hosted and offline — no runtime CDN requests, and no build step.

| File | Source | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `icon-nodes.json` | lucide-static 0.577.0 `icon-nodes.json` | every icon as `[tag, attributes]` tuples |
| `index.js` | generated by `scripts/build-lucide.js` | UMD module exposing `lucideCreateIcon(name)` |
| `package.json` | lucide-static 0.577.0 | pins the version the data came from |
| `LICENSE` | lucide-static 0.577.0 | ISC (portions derived from Feather, MIT) |

Lucide is **ISC licensed**, which permits vendoring and modification as long as the
copyright notice and permission notice are kept — `LICENSE` carries both.

## Usage

The module is loaded as a classic script before the app's inline script, so the icon
data is available synchronously while the markup is built:

```html
<script src="/vendor/lucide/index.js"></script>
```

```js
lucideCreateIcon('image-plus'); // => '<path .../><circle .../>' — SVG children only
lucideCreateIcon('not-an-icon'); // => '' (unknown names render nothing)
lucideCreateIcon.version;        // => '0.577.0'
```

The app wraps that markup in the actual `<svg>` chrome (`index.html`, `iconMarkup`),
so path data stays free of presentation attributes and call sites only choose a size.

## Updating

```sh
npm pack lucide-static@latest
tar -xzf lucide-static-*.tgz
cp package/icon-nodes.json vendor/lucide/icon-nodes.json
cp package/LICENSE         vendor/lucide/LICENSE
# update name/version/license in vendor/lucide/package.json from package/package.json
node scripts/build-lucide.js
npm test
```

`scripts/build-lucide.js` reads `vendor/lucide/package.json` for the version it stamps
into `index.js`, so keep the two in sync. 0.577.0 is pinned deliberately: `icon-nodes`
reaches ~6 MB from 1.x onward with no gain for the icons used here.
